extracted.name: Soup maker leek and potato soup
extracted.description: Serve up this creamy leek and potato soup on cold days when you want something warming and comforting. Made with a soup maker, it's good for lunch or supper
ingredient_lines: 225g potatoes peeled and cut into 1cm pieces
1 small onion cut the same size as the potatoes
60ml whipping cream plus a drizzle to serve
instruction_lines: Put the potatoes, onions, most of the leeks (keep a handful of the white leek for later) and chicken stock into a soup maker and press the ‘smooth soup’ function. Make sure you don’t fill the soup maker above the max fill line.
Once the cycle has complete, add most of the cream and all the milk, and blend again briefly. Use the ‘keep warm’ or ‘heat’ function to keep the soup warm while you make the topping.
Finely shred the remaining white part of the leek. Heat the butter in a small frying pan, and gently cook the leek for a few mins until it is softened but not coloured.
Drizzle the remaining cream over the soup, and top with the leeks, a scattering of chives and some black pepper.
